note: R101 P0 (PULPIT_R101_2026-10-28 §7, §8, §10, §12): the desktop layer under the windows - always mounted, drawn where no window covers it. Everything here is a preset (CLAUDE.md: lists are examples): the sections and their order (setting desktop_sections overrides), the texts, the last_window_close values the page knows (setting last_window_close, an open value) and the emergency path (setting desktop_emergency_path). An unknown section id is skipped with the advisory desktop_section_unknown, never an error. P0 was the mechanism; D2 adds the section `icons` (the pins of the desktop, PULPIT_R101 §4) and the faint graph under them, both from the view declaration chosen by the setting desktop_declaration (`declarations`, preset pulpit_graf). Sections listed in sections_more are drawn behind the button "Więcej" (and a long press on the empty desktop), so nothing P0 offered disappears.

icons.note: R101 D2: the icons of the desktop - nodes pinned to it (perspective pinned_on read from the kernel), laid out by the coordinates of the declaration (icon_grid); a tap opens the target (open_targets)

sentence.note: a sentence goes to the chat composer of a chat window (restored or opened), the same route as typing it there

restore.note: minimized windows of the layout, a tap restores one

open.note: every kind of window_kinds.json; a planned kind or a kind the page cannot open by itself yet is shown greyed with its reason, never hidden

layouts.note: the shipped layouts and the person's saved ones (W5)

sentence.note: true: the sentence is sent from the composer at once; false: it waits in the composer

emergency.note: the one path kept when the sections leave none (B3); setting desktop_emergency_path=false switches it off, the desktop then says what is missing (advisory desktop_no_path)

last_window_close.note: open value: desktop | close_app | reopen:<kind> | layout:<id> [examples]; an unknown value is read as desktop with the advisory last_window_close_unknown

hint.pl: Tu zawsze możesz otworzyć nowe okno.
hint.en: From here you can always open a new window.

sentence_label.en: Write what you want to do

unavailable_cannot_open.pl: Ten rodzaj okna otwiera się dziś tylko z innego okna; strona nie umie go jeszcze otworzyć sama.
unavailable_cannot_open.en: This kind of window opens today only from another window; the page cannot open it by itself yet.

show_receipt.pl: Widać pulpit; okna są zwinięte, „cofnij układ” je przywróci.
show_receipt.en: The desktop is shown; the windows are minimized, “undo layout” brings them back.

show_receipt_noop.pl: Pulpit już jest widoczny; nic nie zwinięto.
show_receipt_noop.en: The desktop is already shown; nothing was minimized.

background_kind.pl: To jest ten pulpit: jest zawsze pod oknami, jeden na układ; pokazuje go „pokaż pulpit” (Ctrl+Shift+D).
background_kind.en: This is the desktop itself: always under the windows, one per layout; “show the desktop” (Ctrl+Shift+D) shows it.

no_path.pl: Na pulpicie nie ma teraz żadnej drogi do otwarcia okna, bo wyłączono sekcje i drogę awaryjną. Czy to celowe?
no_path.en: The desktop has no way to open a window now: the sections and the emergency path are switched off. Is that intended?

last_close_unknown.pl: Nieznana wartość „po zamknięciu ostatniego okna”: {value}; zostaje pulpit.
last_close_unknown.en: Unknown value of “after the last window closes”: {value}; the desktop stays.

ended_text.pl: Zamknięto ostatnie okno, a ustawienie mówi: zamknij program. Przeglądarka może odmówić zamknięcia karty, której nie otworzył skrypt - wtedy zamknij ją sam.
ended_text.en: The last window was closed and the setting says: close the program. The browser may refuse to close a tab no script opened - then close it yourself.

icons_error.pl: Nie udało się wczytać ikon pulpitu: {error}
icons_error.en: Could not load the desktop icons: {error}

desktop_empty.pl: Na pulpicie nie ma ikon. Przypnij coś zdaniem, np. „przypnij rozmowy do pulpitu”.
desktop_empty.en: The desktop has no icons. Pin something with a sentence, e.g. “pin conversations on the desktop”.

declaration_unknown.en: Unknown desktop declaration “{id}”; the default ({preset}) is used.

element_unsupported.pl: Element deklaracji pulpitu, którego ta strona nie rysuje, pominięty: {id} ({kind}).
element_unsupported.en: A desktop declaration element this page does not draw, skipped: {id} ({kind}).

graph_label.pl: Twój graf w tle: węzłów {n}, krawędzi {e}

nothing_visible.pl: Graf w tle jest niewidoczny (krycie 0). Czy to celowe?
nothing_visible.en: The graph behind is invisible (opacity 0). Is that intended?

minimized_unknown.pl: Nieznana wartość „zminimalizowane okna na pulpicie”: {value}; użyto {preset}.
minimized_unknown.en: Unknown value of “minimized windows on the desktop”: {value}; {preset} is used.

card_empty.pl: Wokół tego węzła nie ma jeszcze nic w grafie.
card_empty.en: Nothing is around this node in the graph yet.

declare_receipt.pl: Pulpit ma teraz wygląd „{label}”. Zdanie „pulpit jako graf” wraca do domyślnego.
declare_receipt.en: The desktop is now “{label}”. The sentence “desktop as graph” brings the default back.

declare_receipt_preset.en: The desktop is back to its default ({label}).

declare_unknown.pl: Nie znam takiego wyglądu pulpitu: „{word}”. Znane: {known}.
declare_unknown.en: I do not know such a desktop: “{word}”. Known: {known}.

trash_confirm_one.pl: Usunąć na zawsze „{title}”? Tego nie da się cofnąć.
trash_confirm_one.en: Delete “{title}” for good? This cannot be undone.

trash_confirm_all.pl: Opróżnić kosz ({count})? Rozmowy znikną razem z wiadomościami, wpisy pamięci zostaną zapomniane, przypięcia i układy usunięte. Tego nie da się cofnąć.
trash_confirm_all.en: Empty the trash ({count})? Conversations go with their messages, memory entries are forgotten, pins and layouts removed. This cannot be undone.

trash_retention_due.pl: {count} rzeczy leży w koszu dłużej niż {days} dni (ustawienie trash_retention_days). Usunąć je teraz na zawsze — czy celowo?
trash_retention_due.en: {count} things have been in the trash longer than {days} days (setting trash_retention_days). Delete them for good now — is that intended?

trash_retention_short.pl: Ustawienie trash_retention_days jest krótsze niż 7 dni — rzeczy mogą zniknąć z kosza, zanim się zorientujesz. Czy celowo?
trash_retention_short.en: The setting trash_retention_days is under 7 days — things may leave the trash before you notice. Is that intended?

layout_trashed.pl: Układ „{name}” jest w koszu; „przywróć układ {name} z kosza” go odda.
layout_trashed.en: The layout “{name}” is in the trash; “restore the layout {name} from the trash” brings it back.

layout_untrashed.en: The layout “{name}” is back from the trash.

arrange_by_count.en: by the number on the badge

arrange_by_declaration.pl: jak w ustawieniu pulpitu (bez ręcznych miejsc)
arrange_by_declaration.en: as the desktop setting has it (no hand places)

arrange_from_person.pl: Ułożenie wspólne dla tego rodzaju urządzenia
arrange_from_person.en: Arrangement shared by this kind of device

arrange_computed_moved.pl: Ikony były liczone; przesunięcie ręką przełączyło ułożenie na siatkę. Cofnij, jeśli to niecelowe.
arrange_computed_moved.en: The icons were computed; a move by hand switched the arrangement to the grid. Undo if that was not intended.

arrangement_mode_unknown.pl: Tryb ułożenia „{mode}” nie jest znany tej stronie — ikony stoją w siatce.
arrangement_mode_unknown.en: The arrangement mode “{mode}” is not known to this page — the icons stand in a grid.

arrangement_unreadable.pl: Ustawienie desktop_arrangement jest nieczytelne — ikony stoją jak domyślnie.
arrangement_unreadable.en: The setting desktop_arrangement is unreadable — the icons stand as by default.

arrange_by_unknown.pl: Nie znam porządku „{by}” — nic nie zmieniłem.
arrange_by_unknown.en: I do not know the order “{by}” — nothing changed.

arrange_done.en: Arranged the icons ({by}). To undo: “Undo the arrangement”.

drop_receipt_set_param_undo.en: Restored the previous value in the window “{screen}”.

drop_no_rule.pl: Nie wiem, co zrobić z «{label}» upuszczonym na {target} - ikona wróciła na miejsce. Reguły upuszczania są w danych pulpitu (interactions.drop_rules).
drop_no_rule.en: I do not know what to do with “{label}” dropped on {target} - the icon went back. The drop rules are desktop data (interactions.drop_rules).

drop_rule_off.pl: Ta reguła upuszczania ({rule}) jest wyłączona dla tego rodzaju urządzenia.
drop_rule_off.en: This drop rule ({rule}) is off for this kind of device.

drop_do_unknown.pl: Reguła upuszczania {rule} każe zrobić coś, czego ta strona nie umie ({do}); nic nie zrobiłem.
drop_do_unknown.en: The drop rule {rule} asks for something this page cannot do ({do}); nothing was done.

drag_hint_long_press.pl: Przytrzymaj ikonę chwilę, potem przeciągnij; samo przesunięcie palcem przewija pulpit.
drag_hint_long_press.en: Hold an icon a moment, then drag; a plain swipe scrolls the desktop.

drag_hint_handle.pl: Przeciągaj ikonę za uchwyt ⠿; reszta ikony przewija pulpit.
drag_hint_handle.en: Drag an icon by its handle ⠿; the rest of the icon scrolls the desktop.

icon_menu_unknown.pl: Pozycja menu ikony „{id}” nie jest znana tej stronie.
icon_menu_unknown.en: The icon menu item “{id}” is unknown to this page.

desktop_key_unknown.pl: Klawisz {combo} wskazuje działanie „{op}”, którego pulpit nie zna.
desktop_key_unknown.en: The key {combo} names an operation “{op}” the desktop does not know.

keys_hint.pl: Klawiatura: strzałki przechodzą między ikonami, Enter otwiera, Delete przenosi do kosza, Shift+F10 otwiera menu.
keys_hint.en: Keyboard: the arrows move between icons, Enter opens, Delete moves to the trash, Shift+F10 opens the menu.

arrange_move_hint.pl: Przytrzymaj i przeciągnij ikonę, żeby ją przestawić.
arrange_move_hint.en: Hold and drag an icon to move it.

arrange_no_icons.pl: Na pulpicie nie ma jeszcze ikon do ułożenia (pulpit nie był pokazany albo nie ma ikon).
arrange_no_icons.en: The desktop has no icons to arrange yet (it was not shown, or it has no icons).

arrange_unknown.pl: Nie wiem, jak ułożyć ikony „{word}”. Umiem: {known}.
arrange_unknown.en: I do not know how to arrange the icons “{word}”. I can: {known}.

pulpit_graf.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.2 [preset, the default chosen by the owner 2026-10-28]: the pinned nodes as icons, the rest of the person's graph faint, only that it exists. Every number is a preset.

elements.seed_note: the first pins, written once as ordinary pinned_on links (window.pin) when the desktop node does not exist yet; the person may unpin any of them - examples, not a rule (owner's list + his associations, PULPIT §4.3)

pulpit_ikony.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: only the pins, no graph behind them (pulpit_graf with the rest at opacity 0).

pulpit_start.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: a launcher - a tile for every kind of window (planned ones greyed with their reason), the latest conversations and the layouts; the sentence field stays. Limits are presets.

pulpit_polka.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: only the shelf - the minimized windows as icons over the whole background (a taskbar as the desktop); a tap restores one. The sentence field and "More…" stay as the ways to a new window (§12 P1).

pulpit_pusty.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: almost nothing - the background and one way in: the sentence field, and a long press (or "More…") for every kind of window (§12 P1).

pulpit_karta.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1 [preset]: the desktop is the card of the node party:self (its name and what is around it in the graph, a tap opens the navigator there) with the pinned icons under it.

pulpit_graf_zywy.note: PULPIT_R101 §3.1/§3.2 [preset]: as pulpit_graf, but the graph behind follows the coupling channel focus (W6): the focus of the navigator window (its own value, or the shared channel focus when bound); with no such window it falls back to party:self.

open_targets.note: address of an icon -> the window it opens (longest prefix wins; $address = the whole address, $rest = what follows the prefix). The kind goes through window_kinds.json: a planned kind is shown greyed with its reason, a kind the page cannot open yet too. An address no prefix knows opens fallback. Examples, an open list.

address_labels.note: the label of an icon when the pin carries no label_override (a representative node is labelled with its address): longest prefix wins, else the node's own label. Examples.

glyphs.note: the sign of an icon by the longest address prefix (element icon, glyph: address) - plain text symbols, a preset; a node's own metadata.glyph or the pin's glyph wins.

declaration_words.note: the words a sentence („pulpit jako ikony”, „desktop as start”) may name a declaration with, besides its id (with or without pulpit_) and its label. Examples, an open list.

minimized.note: setting desktop_minimized (PULPIT §8, §9): where a minimized window shows on the desktop - shelf (the list section restore), icons (a strip of icons at the bottom of the desktop, a taskbar), both, none [examples; presets per device class]. An unknown value is the preset with the advisory desktop_minimized_unknown.

trash.note: R101 D4 (PULPIT_R101 §5): the trash window and the drop on the trash. drop_on_trash (setting; preset target): target = the thing of the icon (conv: -> conversation.trash, memory: -> memory.trash; another address -> its pin), pin = only the icon [examples]. retention_short_days: the threshold of the advisory trash_retention_short (preset 7).

arrangement.note: R101 D5 (PULPIT §6): presets of the setting desktop_arrangement. preset = the arrangement when nothing is written (one value for every class or {<class>: value}); modes_known, arrange_by are open lists of what this page draws today (examples of the mechanism); levels = where a hand move is written (installation = this browser, person = every device of the class), installation wins when read; journal_limit null = no limit; free_rows = the height of the free area in cells. class_fallback: a class with no value of its own reads the value of these classes (snapped to its own grid), so a phone turned sideways - another device class by width - keeps where its icons stood; the first move there writes its own value.

interactions.note: R101 D6 (PULPIT §13 interactions, §14 row D6): what a drop does, as data. A drag of a desktop icon (or of a floating window's title bar) ends over a stack of things under the pointer (hits: another icon by address, a window by id and kind - floating frame or its minimized icon/shelf entry -, the empty desktop). drop_rules are walked in order for every hit from the top down; the first rule whose source and target match wins. source: an address prefix ("" = any icon), a list of prefixes, or {window: true | <kind> | [kinds]} for a dragged window. target: {icon: <prefix | [prefixes]>}, {window_kind: <kind | [kinds] | "*">}, {window_param: <param>} (any window whose kind reads that coupling parameter, coupling.json kind_params), {desktop: true}. do: set_param {param, value} with $address / $rest (what follows the matched source prefix) - the value goes to that window's parameter through the W6 coupling (a minimized window is restored and focused first); trash (what drop_on_trash says, as the menu item „Do kosza”); close (the dragged window); move (the D5 move within the grid). An icon dropped on the empty desktop with no matching rule is the D5 move; a drop on something no rule names returns the icon and raises the non-blocking advisory drop_no_rule. enabled: true/false or {<device class>: bool} (a rule off for a class says so when tried: drop_rule_off). Not in this package (named by the design, not done - no rule here, so nothing pretends): a window dropped on the empty desktop (minimize into a zone), a navigator node dropped on the desktop (pin), an icon dropped on an icon (a group). receipt_ms: how long the receipt chip stays (null = until the next one).
interactions.icon_menu_note: The items of the icon menu (a long press, the context-menu key or a right click on an icon), in this order; known today: open (as a tap), trash (as D4; only for a trashable address), close (closes the menu). An unknown item is skipped with the advisory icon_menu_unknown.
